title: GPUPhysBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Correct and Efficient GPU Physics Simulation
title_zh: GPU 物理模拟基准测试

paragraphs.en: Writing fast GPU code for physical simulation is difficult: implementations must preserve numerical accuracy while handling irregular data access, synchronization, and iterative solvers. We introduce GPUPhysBench, a benchmark of 50 tasks testing whether coding agents can meet these demands. Tasks cover fluids, deformable solids, and granular materials, from individual simulation operators to complete simulators. Agents write, compile, test, and optimize GPU code with access to a NVIDIA GPU under fixed time budgets. We report pass rates and runtime performance relative to expert-optimized reference implementations. In a single-attempt evaluation of six frontier model-harness pairs, the two strongest pass all 50 tasks, but even the fastest reaches at least 0.9 × 0.9\times the reference speed on only 22% of them, and no submission is more than 5% faster than the reference. The largest gaps arise in collision detection, constraint solving, and iterative solvers. GPUPhysBench brings physical simulation workloads to coding-agent evaluation, testing both the ability to implement numerical methods correctly and the ability to make them run efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 编写用于物理模拟的高速 GPU 代码十分困难：实现方案必须在处理不规则数据访问、同步和迭代求解器的同时，保持数值精度。 我们提出了 GPUPhysBench，这是一个包含 50 个任务的基准测试，用于检验编码智能体能否满足这些需求。 这些任务涵盖了流体、可变形固体和颗粒材料，从单个模拟算子到完整的模拟器均有涉及。 智能体在固定的时间限制内，使用 NVIDIA GPU 编写、编译、测试并优化 GPU 代码。 我们报告了通过率以及与专家优化的参考实现相比的运行时间性能。 在六个前沿模型与工具组合的单次尝试评估中，表现最强的两个组合通过了全部 50 个任务，但即便是最快的组合，也仅在 22% 的任务上达到了参考实现的至少 0.9 × 0.9 倍速度，且没有任何提交方案比参考实现快超过 5%。 最大的性能差距出现在碰撞检测、约束求解和迭代求解器中。 GPUPhysBench 将物理模拟的工作负载引入编码智能体的评估中，既检验了正确实现数值方法的能力，也检验了高效运行这些方法的能力。

paragraphs.en: Modern physical simulation and machine learning rely on GPUs for large-scale workloads, but realizing this performance requires carefully optimized CUDA implementations that demand expertise in numerical algorithms, parallel programming, and hardware-aware optimization. paragraphs.en: Physical simulation is an important domain. Beyond long-standing uses in video games ( Macklin et al., 2014 ) , aerospace engineering, and manufacturing, it offers a scalable and controllable source of physically plausible interaction data for world models and embodied intelligence ( Makoviychuk et al., 2021 ) , where real-world data collection is costly and slow. This demand calls for simulators that are both accurate and efficient, increasing the value of automating their GPU implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 物理模拟是一个重要的领域。 除了长期以来在电子游戏（Macklin 等人，2014）、航空航天工程和制造业中的应用之外，物理模拟还为世界模型和具身智能提供了一种可扩展且可控的、具有物理合理性的交互数据源（Makoviychuk 等人，2021），尤其是在现实世界的数据采集成本高昂且效率低下的情况下。 这种需求催生了对兼具准确性和高效性的模拟器的需求，从而提升了对其 GPU 实现进行自动化的价值。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks do not cover this setting. Simulation-oriented evaluations emphasize numerical correctness or rely on CPU-based scientific software and established solver libraries ( Somasekharan et al., 2025 ; Hang et al., 2026 ) , while benchmarks for efficient GPU code are dominated by machine-learning operators ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2026 ) ; even CUDABench ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) includes only a handful of elementary numerical examples. Unlike regular tensor operators, simulators combine structured grids with particles, meshes, and dynamically evolving neighborhoods, so their bottlenecks include irregular memory access, atomic contention ( Gao et al., 2018 ) , neighbor search, and load imbalance. Optimizing them also requires numerical reasoning: agents must preserve the prescribed discretization and stability properties, and in solver-dominated tasks the choice of algorithm and preconditioner determines runtime through convergence.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试并未涵盖这种设置。 以模拟为导向的评估强调数值正确性，或依赖基于 CPU 的科学软件和成熟的求解器库（Somasekharan 等人，2025；Hang 等人，2026），而针对高效 GPU 代码的基准测试则主要由机器学习算子主导（Ouyang 等人，2025；Guan 等人，2026）；即便是 CUDABench（Zhu 等人，2026），也只包含少数几个基础数值示例。 与常规的张量算子不同，模拟器将结构化网格与粒子、网格和动态演化的邻域相结合，因此其性能瓶颈包括不规则的内存访问、原子操作竞争（Gao 等人，2018）、邻居搜索以及负载不均衡。 优化这些模拟器还需要数值推理能力：智能体必须保持预定的离散化和稳定性特性；在由求解器主导的任务中，算法和预条件子的选择会通过收敛性决定运行时间。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks are also limited in how they evaluate generated code. Most rely on single-turn generation or short, fixed loops of generation, verification, and profiling. These assess local kernel synthesis but not the ability of modern coding agents to plan, modify files, compile and run programs, diagnose failures, and improve an implementation over an extended trajectory. Evaluating such agents requires a controlled environment that preserves their autonomy while standardizing resource budgets and hardware access.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试在评估生成代码的方式上也存在局限性。 大多数基准测试依赖单次生成，或采用生成、验证和性能分析之间的短而固定的循环流程。 这些测试能够评估局部内核的生成能力，但无法衡量现代编码智能体在规划、修改文件、编译和运行程序、诊断故障以及在整个执行过程中持续改进实现方面的能力。 要评估这类智能体，需要一个受控的环境，既能保持其自主性，又能对资源预算和硬件访问进行标准化。

paragraphs.en: To address both gaps, we introduce GPUPhysBench, a benchmark of 50 coding tasks spanning classical methods for fluid dynamics, deformable solids, and granular materials. Every task includes standardized test data and a reference implementation that human experts have numerically validated and optimized. We evaluate frontier models in full-featured coding-agent harnesses, such as Codex CLI and Claude Code, inside a sandbox that isolates references and evaluators and fixes time budgets and hardware. This design measures pass rates and runtime relative to expert implementations while capturing the long-horizon, tool-using optimization of complete coding-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 为了填补这两个空白，我们提出了 GPUPhysBench——一个包含 50 个编码任务的基准测试，涵盖了流体动力学、可变形固体和颗粒材料的经典方法。 每个任务都包含了标准化的测试数据以及由人类专家经过数值验证并优化的参考实现。 我们在功能完整的编码智能体工具中（例如 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code），于一个能够隔离参考实现与评估器、并固定时间预算和硬件环境的沙盒内，对前沿模型进行了评估。 这种设计能够衡量通过率和运行时间与专家实现相比的表现，同时捕捉到完整编码智能体系统在长期任务中利用工具进行优化的能力。

paragraphs.en: A line of benchmarks studies how well LLMs can write high-performance GPU kernels for ML workloads. KernelBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) and MultiKernelBench ( Wen et al., 2025 ) score generated kernels on correctness and speedup over PyTorch baselines. TritonBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) , Geak ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and TritonGym ( Guan et al., 2026 ) target the Triton DSL ( Tillet et al., 2019 ) . Beyond one-shot generation, agentic systems iteratively optimize kernels using compilation, testing, and profiling feedback. They explore the optimization space through multi-agent refinement loops ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , tree search ( Dong et al., 2026b ; Cao et al., 2026 ) , or evolutionary search with LLM-based variation operators ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Yoo et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一系列基准测试研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在编写用于机器学习工作负载的高性能 GPU 内核方面的能力。 KernelBench（Ouyang 等，2025）和 MultiKernelBench（Wen 等，2025）通过正确性和相对于 PyTorch 基线版本的加速程度对生成的内核进行评分。 TritonBench（Li 等，2025）、Geak（Wang 等，2025）和 TritonGym（Guan 等，2026）均以 Triton DSL（Tillet 等，2019）为目标。 除了一次性生成之外，智能体系统还通过编译、测试和性能分析反馈对内核进行迭代优化。 它们通过多智能体优化循环（Wei 等，2025；Sun 等，2026；Zhang 等，2025）、树搜索（Dong 等，2026b；Cao 等，2026）或基于 LLM 的变异算子的进化搜索（Chen 等，2026；Liao 等，2025；Yoo 等，2026）来探索优化空间。

paragraphs.en: Several benchmarks test LLM-written scientific code: SciCode ( Tian et al., 2024 ) curates research coding problems across the natural sciences, while CFDLLMBench ( Somasekharan et al., 2025 ) and PDEAgent-Bench ( Hang et al., 2026 ) check generated CFD and PDE solvers for accuracy and efficiency. Beyond benchmarks, agentic systems apply LLMs to scientific computing workflows: they generate PDE solver code and refine it with execution feedback ( Li et al., 2026a ; Dong et al., 2026a ) , automate end-to-end OpenFOAM workflows ( Yue et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) , or tackle neighboring tasks such as PDE control ( Soroco et al., 2025 ) , discovery ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , and reduced-order modeling ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多项基准测试用于评估由大型语言模型（LLM）编写的科学代码：SciCode（Tian 等人，2024）收集了自然科学领域的研究编码问题，而 CFDLLMBench（Somasekharan 等人，2025）和 PDEAgent-Bench（Hang 等人，2026）则用于检验所生成的 CFD 和 PDE 求解器的准确性与效率。 除了基准测试之外，智能体系统还将大型语言模型应用于科学计算工作流程：它们能够生成偏微分方程（PDE）求解器代码，并通过执行反馈进行优化（Li 等人，2026a；Dong 等人，2026a），自动化 OpenFOAM 的全流程操作（Yue 等人，2026；Yue 等人，2025），或处理相关的任务，例如 PDE 控制（Soroco 等人，2025）、科学发现（Luo 等人，2025）以及降阶建模（Wang 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: GPUPhysBench comprises 50 coding tasks in fluid dynamics, deformable solids, and granular materials, drawn from well-established methods in physical simulation. We select tasks that represent widely used algorithms, pose nontrivial numerical and GPU optimization challenges, and support automatic correctness verification and reliable performance measurement. Using established methods provides clear mathematical specifications and interpretable failure modes while leaving agents substantial freedom in algorithmic and low-level implementation. The fluid tasks use Eulerian grid solvers ( Zehnder et al., 2018 ) , particle-in-cell/fluid-implicit-particle (PIC/FLIP) and affine particle-in-cell (APIC) methods ( Jiang et al., 2015 ) , position-based fluids (PBF) ( Macklin and Müller, 2013 ) , and the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) ( Li et al., 2026b ) . The solid and granular tasks use mass-spring systems ( Liu et al., 2013 ) , the finite element method (FEM) ( Sifakis and Barbic, 2012 ) , the material point method (MPM) ( Stomakhin et al., 2013 ) , extended position-based dynamics (XPBD) ( Macklin et al., 2016 ) , continuous collision detection (CCD) ( Brochu et al., 2012 ) , and the discrete element method (DEM) ( Lu et al., 2022 ) . Appendix E describes the covered methods and lists all tasks with their categories.
paragraphs.zh: GPUPhysBench 包含 50 个编码任务，涵盖流体动力学、可变形固体和颗粒材料领域，这些任务均源自物理模拟中的成熟方法。 我们挑选的任务代表了广泛使用的算法，提出了非平凡的数值计算和 GPU 优化挑战，并支持自动正确性验证与可靠的性能测量。 采用成熟方法可提供清晰的数学规范与可解释的失效模式，同时为智能体在算法和底层实现方面保留了充分的自由度。 流体任务使用欧拉网格求解器（Zehnder 等人，2018）、粒子-在-细胞/流体隐式粒子（PIC/FLIP）和仿射粒子-在-细胞（APIC）方法（Jiang 等人，2015）、基于位置的流体（PBF）（Macklin 和 Müller，2013），以及格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）（Li 等人，2026b）。 固体和颗粒任务使用质量-弹簧系统（Liu 等人，2013）、有限元法（FEM）（Sifakis 和 Barbic，2012）、材料点法（MPM）（Stomakhin 等人，2013）、扩展基于位置的动态方法（XPBD）（Macklin 等人，2016）、连续碰撞检测（CCD）（Brochu 等人，2012），以及离散元法（DEM）（Lu 等人，2022）。 附录 E 描述了所涵盖的方法，并列出了所有任务及其分类。

paragraphs.en: The tasks operate on structured grids, particles, lattices, and meshes, covering GPU computation patterns such as stencils, iterative linear solves, atomic scatter and gather, irregular neighborhood interactions, constraint projection, and collision processing. Operator tasks isolate performance-critical operations for fine-grained analysis, while full-simulator tasks require agents to integrate multiple stages into a complete, efficient simulator that preserves numerical behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务在结构化网格、粒子、晶格和网格上进行操作，涵盖了 GPU 计算模式，例如模板运算、迭代线性求解、原子级散射与收集、不规则邻域交互、约束投影和碰撞处理。 算子任务将性能关键的操作分离出来以进行精细分析，而完整模拟器任务则要求智能体将多个阶段整合为一个完整的、高效的模拟器，同时保持其数值行为。

paragraphs.en: Each task comes with an expert-optimized CUDA reference implementation that defines both the correctness baseline and the performance target. We build the references from open-source, high-performance simulation code released with SIGGRAPH papers and courses, such as Fast UAAMG ( Shao et al., 2022 ) , GPUMPM ( Gao et al., 2018 ) , and an LBM course ( Li et al., 2026b ) ; this code is written in C++, earlier versions of CUDA, and NVIDIA Warp ( Macklin, 2022 ) . Claude Fable translates it into CUDA, and human experts then rewrite and optimize the result for modern GPUs. Although the upstream code may appear in the pretraining data of the evaluated models, the expert-optimized references are never visible to agents, and the performance gaps in our experiments (Section 4.2 ) indicate that recalling the upstream code does not by itself reach reference performance. We validate each reference numerically against a serial baseline and run complete multi-step simulations to confirm that it produces physically valid behavior (Figure 1 ; Appendix G ). The references are also competitive with established GPU libraries: on the tasks’ public inputs, they are 9.0 × 9.0\times faster than AMGX ( Naumov et al., 2015 ) on the Poisson solve and 2.6 2.6 – 7.0 × 7.0\times faster than ports of Warp and Taichi ( Hu et al., 2019 ) examples (Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都附带一个由专家优化的 CUDA 参考实现，该实现既定义了正确性基准，也设定了性能目标。 我们从随 SIGGRAPH 论文和课程发布的开源高性能模拟代码中构建这些参考实现，例如 Fast UAAMG（Shao 等，2022）、GPUMPM（Gao 等，2018）以及一门 LBM 课程（Li 等，2026b）；这些代码使用 C++、早期版本的 CUDA 和 NVIDIA Warp（Macklin，2022）编写。 Claude Fable 将其转换为 CUDA，随后由人类专家对结果进行重写和优化，以适应现代 GPU。 尽管上游代码可能出现在被评估模型的前训练数据中，但经过专家优化的参考实现绝不会暴露给智能体；我们实验中观察到的性能差距（第 4.2 节）表明，仅靠回忆上游代码本身无法达到参考性能水平。 我们通过串行基准对每个参考实现进行数值验证，并运行完整的多步骤模拟，以确认其能产生物理上有效的行为（图 1；附录 G）。 这些参考实现在与成熟的 GPU 库的对比中也具有竞争力：在任务的公开输入数据上，它们在泊松方程求解任务中比 AMGX（Naumov 等，2015）快 9.0 × 9.0\times，在 Warp 和 Taichi（Hu 等，2019）示例的移植版本中则分别快 2.6–7.0 × 7.0\times（附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate agents in production-grade coding harnesses, such as Claude Code, that support file editing and tool use. Prior evaluations may sample or refine over multiple API calls, but each code-generating call emits a complete implementation, both in KernelBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) and in the scripted multi-call workflows evaluated by TritonGym ( Guan et al., 2026 ) . In our tests, generating a complete implementation in one call breaks down for large simulators, such as semi-implicit MPM, because the model’s reasoning and code together can exceed the per-call token limit. Persistent harnesses instead let agents build a simulator incrementally, interleaving edits with compilation, testing, and optimization in their own order within the time budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在支持文件编辑和工具使用的生产级编码环境中评估智能体，例如 Claude Code。 以往的评估可能会通过多次 API 调用进行采样或优化，但在 KernelBench（Ouyang 等人，2025）以及 TritonGym（Guan 等人，2026）所评估的脚本化多调用工作流程中，每次代码生成调用都会输出一个完整的实现。 在我们的测试中，对于像半隐式 MPM 这样的大型模拟器，单次调用生成完整实现的方法会失效，因为模型的推理过程与代码总和可能超出单次调用的令牌限制。 相比之下，持续运行的环境允许智能体逐步构建模拟器，在时间预算内按自身顺序交替进行编辑、编译、测试和优化。

paragraphs.en: The prompt specifies the numerical method, including the governing equations or update rules, discretization, boundary conditions, and convergence criteria where applicable, together with the input and output arrays, scalar parameters, performance objective, and execution constraints. The workspace contains a CUDA source file, an xmake build file, and a Python driver, and the environment provides a GPU and the tooling to build and run the extension. The driver constructs the public inputs and runs the compiled module, so the agent can inspect inputs, outputs, and timing, but it provides no reference outputs or correctness verdicts. Online access is prohibited.
paragraphs.zh: 该提示指定了数值方法，包括控制方程或更新规则、离散化、边界条件（如适用）和收敛标准，以及输入输出数组、标量参数、性能目标和执行约束。 工作区包含一个 CUDA 源文件、一个 xmake 构建文件和 Python 驱动程序，而环境则提供 GPU 以及用于构建和运行扩展的工具。 驱动程序会构建公共输入并运行编译好的模块，因此智能体可以检查输入、输出和时间，但不会提供任何参考输出或正确性判定。 禁止在线访问。

paragraphs.en: The starter code defines a task-specific class whose pybind11 bindings and input() / exec() / output() methods are fixed: they upload the inputs to device buffers, time the computation, and copy the output back. The agent implements allocate() , compute() , and release() , and may add CUDA kernels, internal buffers, and its own data layout; any layout conversion or preprocessing runs inside the timed compute() , while the untimed allocate() may only allocate memory from shapes and scalar parameters. The fixed code and module interface must be preserved, and build changes are limited to compilation flags. Appendix A gives the complete prompt and starter code for a Neumann Poisson task.
paragraphs.zh: 初始代码定义了一个任务特定的类，其 pybind11 绑定以及 input() / exec() / output() 方法是固定的：它们将输入上传到设备缓冲区，计时计算过程，并将输出复制回来。 智能体实现了 allocate()、compute() 和 release() 方法，并可以添加 CUDA 内核、内部缓冲区以及自身的数据布局；任何布局转换或预处理都在计时的 compute() 方法内部执行，而未计时的 allocate() 方法只能根据形状和标量参数分配内存。 必须保留固定的代码和模块接口，且构建方面的更改仅限于编译标志。 附录 A 提供了 Neumann Poisson 任务的完整提示词和初始代码。

paragraphs.en: All floating-point computation and storage must use FP32. A submission must pass task-specific checks, such as relative ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error or solver convergence, on the outputs of its timed calls for both public and hidden inputs. The hidden inputs are withheld during development. They keep the problem size but change the data through different random seeds and initial conditions and, for some tasks, different geometry or solver coefficients (Appendix E.2 ). Any computational strategy is allowed as long as it meets these accuracy requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 所有浮点计算和存储都必须使用 FP32。 提交方案必须通过任务特定的检查，例如相对 ℓ₂ 误差或求解器收敛性，这些检查需针对其定时调用的输出在公开输入和隐藏输入上均有效。 开发阶段不会提供隐藏输入。 它们保持问题规模不变，但通过不同的随机种子和初始条件来改变数据；对于某些任务，还会改变几何结构或求解器系数（附录 E.2）。 只要满足这些精度要求，任何计算策略都是允许的。

sents.en: The hidden inputs are withheld during development.
sents.zh: 开发阶段不会提供隐藏输入。

sents.en: They keep the problem size but change the data through different random seeds and initial conditions and, for some tasks, different geometry or solver coefficients (Appendix E.2 ).
sents.zh: 它们保持问题规模不变，但通过不同的随机种子和初始条件来改变数据；对于某些任务，还会改变几何结构或求解器系数（附录 E.2）。

sents.en: Any computational strategy is allowed as long as it meets these accuracy requirements.
sents.zh: 只要满足这些精度要求，任何计算策略都是允许的。

paragraphs.en: Most checks compare the submission’s output with the reference output by relative ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error on the quantity the step changes; for example, particle positions are compared by their displacement over the step, so that large absolute coordinates cannot hide an error in the update. Linear and Newton solves instead require the true residual of the returned solution to fall below the prescribed solver tolerance. Each tolerance is set above the variation between correct FP32 implementations, which differ in rounding, reduction order, and the order of atomic accumulation, and well below the effect of plausible implementation errors, such as a missing term or a flipped sign. Appendices C.5 and C.6 confirm both bounds: correct outputs stay well below their tolerances and erroneous ones far above them, so moderately different thresholds would not change any outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数检查通过比较提交结果的输出与参考输出在步长变化量上的相对 ℓ₂ 误差来实现；例如，粒子位置是通过其在步长内的位移进行比较的，这样较大的绝对坐标就无法掩盖更新过程中的错误。 而线性求解和牛顿求解则要求返回解的真实残差低于规定的求解器容限。 每个容限都设定在正确 FP32 实现之间的差异之上——这些差异体现在舍入、归约顺序和原子累加的顺序上，并且远低于可能存在的实现错误（例如漏项或符号翻转）所带来的影响。 附录 C.5 和 C.6 证实了这两个界限：正确的输出结果远低于其容限，而错误的结果则远高于容限，因此适度不同的阈值不会改变任何结果。

paragraphs.en: The objective is to minimize GPU execution time while satisfying the numerical specification. CUDA events measure all GPU work performed during exec() , including auxiliary computation and solver iterations, while input upload and output download are excluded through the separate interface methods. The generated and reference implementations are evaluated on identical inputs under the same timing protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 目标是在满足数值规格的同时，将 GPU 执行时间最小化。 CUDA 事件会测量 exec() 期间执行的所有 GPU 工作，包括辅助计算和求解器迭代，而输入上传和输出下载则通过独立的接口方法排除在外。 生成的实现和参考实现将在相同的输入和相同的计时协议下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: The agent receives a wall-clock budget of 30 minutes for operator tasks and 60 minutes for full-simulator tasks, covering implementation, compilation, testing, and optimization. The prompt states the budget and absolute deadline. The agent may independently check the current time using the date command and compare it with the deadline to decide whether to continue optimizing or finalize its submission. At most one agent, including the main agent and any subagents, may be active at a time. Any delegated execution shares the same task-level wall-clock budget. The run is terminated when the budget expires, and the submitted source and build configuration present when the agent finishes or reaches the deadline are used for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体获得的实际时间预算为：操作任务 30 分钟，完整模拟器任务 60 分钟，后者涵盖实现、编译、测试和优化。 提示语中说明了预算和绝对截止日期。 该智能体可独立使用 date 命令查询当前时间，并与截止日期进行比较，以决定是否继续优化或最终提交其成果。 同一时间最多只有一个智能体（包括主智能体和任何子智能体）处于活跃状态。 任何委托的执行都共享相同的任务级实际时间预算。 当预算用尽时，运行将终止；智能体完成操作或达到截止日期时已提交的源代码和构建配置将用于评估。

paragraphs.en: Each task runs in a Docker container, in a separate working directory that contains only the agent-facing files. The agent runs as an unprivileged user whose permissions block access to the benchmark project, including references and evaluators, and the harness verifies this isolation before launch. For scoring, the harness restores the fixed starter-code sections and rebuilds the submission in a clean directory with the protected driver and evaluator, ignoring any prebuilt module left by the agent.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate coding agents on GPUPhysBench to assess their ability to produce numerically correct and efficient GPU simulation programs. We compare six model-harness pairs against expert implementations in terms of correctness, pass rate, and runtime performance, and analyze the generated programs to identify the factors that contribute to the remaining performance gap.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 GPUPhysBench 上对编码智能体进行评估，以考察其生成数值准确且高效的 GPU 模拟程序的能力。 我们从正确性、通过率以及运行时性能等方面，将六组模型与工具的组合方案同专家实现的版本进行了对比，并分析了所生成的程序，以识别导致剩余性能差距的因素。

sents.en: We compare six model-harness pairs against expert implementations in terms of correctness, pass rate, and runtime performance, and analyze the generated programs to identify the factors that contribute to the remaining performance gap.

paragraphs.en: All agent development and evaluation run on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (Ada Lovelace), so agents tune on the same GPU that scores them, inside an Ubuntu-based CUDA Docker image with Python, pybind11, and xmake. For each implementation and input set, we report the minimum of five timed calls, each in a fresh process after three warm-up calls on the other input set; speedups use the hidden-input timings.
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体的开发和评估都在单块 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090（Ada Lovelace）上运行，因此智能体在同一个用于评分的 GPU 上进行调优，整个过程在一个基于 Ubuntu 的 CUDA Docker 镜像中完成，其中包含了 Python、pybind11 和 xmake。 对于每种实现和输入集，我们报告五次计时调用的最小值；每次调用都在一个新进程中执行，且在此之前会对另一个输入集进行三次预热调用；加速比则使用隐藏输入的计时数据计算得出。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate six frontier models, using their corresponding coding harnesses where possible. We pair Claude-Opus-5 with Claude Code, GPT-5.6-Sol with Codex CLI, Gemini-3.5-Flash with Gemini CLI, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with DeepSeek Harness, and Qwen-3.8-Max with Qwen Code. For GLM-5.3, we use OpenCode instead of ZCode, since the latter is a desktop development environment rather than a CLI harness. We refer to the six systems by their model family: Opus, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and GLM. We configure reasoning effort to high for all applicable harnesses except Gemini CLI, which does not expose a corresponding effort-level setting. Each system receives one attempt per task in Table 1 ; Appendix C.4 reports development time and token usage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了六个前沿模型，并在可能的情况下使用它们对应的编码工具。 我们将 Claude-Opus-5 与 Claude Code、GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Codex CLI、Gemini-3.5-Flash 与 Gemini CLI、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 与 DeepSeek Harness，以及 Qwen-3.8-Max 与 Qwen Code 进行配对。 对于 GLM-5.3，我们使用 OpenCode 而非 ZCode，因为后者是一个桌面开发环境，而不是命令行工具。 我们用模型系列来指代这六个系统：Opus、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen 和 GLM。 对于所有适用的工具，我们将推理强度配置为高，但 Gemini CLI 除外，因为它没有提供相应的强度级别设置。 表 1 中的每个任务，每个系统只有一次尝试；附录 C.4 报告了开发时间和令牌使用量。

sents.en: We pair Claude-Opus-5 with Claude Code, GPT-5.6-Sol with Codex CLI, Gemini-3.5-Flash with Gemini CLI, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with DeepSeek Harness, and Qwen-3.8-Max with Qwen Code.
sents.zh: 我们将 Claude-Opus-5 与 Claude Code、GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Codex CLI、Gemini-3.5-Flash 与 Gemini CLI、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 与 DeepSeek Harness，以及 Qwen-3.8-Max 与 Qwen Code 进行配对。

sents.en: For GLM-5.3, we use OpenCode instead of ZCode, since the latter is a desktop development environment rather than a CLI harness.
sents.zh: 对于 GLM-5.3，我们使用 OpenCode 而非 ZCode，因为后者是一个桌面开发环境，而不是命令行工具。

sents.en: We refer to the six systems by their model family: Opus, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and GLM.
sents.zh: 我们用模型系列来指代这六个系统：Opus、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen 和 GLM。

sents.en: We configure reasoning effort to high for all applicable harnesses except Gemini CLI, which does not expose a corresponding effort-level setting.
sents.zh: 对于所有适用的工具，我们将推理强度配置为高，但 Gemini CLI 除外，因为它没有提供相应的强度级别设置。

sents.en: Each system receives one attempt per task in Table 1 ; Appendix C.4 reports development time and token usage.
sents.zh: 表 1 中的每个任务，每个系统只有一次尝试；附录 C.4 报告了开发时间和令牌使用量。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the performance of six model-harness pairs across all 50 GPUPhysBench tasks. These results assess complete coding systems: each agent must translate a numerical specification into CUDA code, resolve implementation issues, and optimize execution within a fixed time budget. paragraphs.en: Opus and GPT both pass all numerical checks and audits on all 50 tasks, including full simulators that require multiple numerical stages to work together, achieving 100% correctness and pass rate. Gemini reaches 88% on both metrics, DeepSeek 86%, and Qwen 52%, while GLM reaches 88% correctness and an 86% pass rate. This result should be read in light of the task format: each prompt prescribes the numerical method, discretization, boundary conditions, and convergence criteria, so the tasks test faithful implementation of a given method rather than the choice of physical model. For the strongest systems, correctness is therefore close to saturation, and performance is the axis on which GPUPhysBench separates them.
paragraphs.zh: Opus 和 GPT 在所有 50 项任务中均通过了所有的数值检验和审核，包括需要多个数值阶段协同工作的完整模拟器，正确率和通过率均达到 100%。 Gemini 在这两项指标上均达到 88%，DeepSeek 为 86%，Qwen 为 52%，而 GLM 的正确率达到 88%，通过率为 86%。 解读这一结果时，需结合任务格式：每个提示词都规定了数值方法、离散化方式、边界条件和收敛标准，因此这些任务测试的是对给定方法的忠实实现，而非物理模型的选择。 对于最强的系统而言，正确率已接近饱和，因此性能成为 GPUPhysBench 区分它们的关键指标。

paragraphs.en: To compare benchmark outcomes across computational structures, we group tasks into six categories according to their numerical methods and computational structure (Figure 2 ). Local Grid and Lattice Computations covers advection, LBM operations, and local surface-tension and phase-field updates. Particle-Grid Methods includes transfer operators and complete PIC/FLIP, APIC, and MPM steps. Local Interaction Updates covers explicit elasticity, contact-force evaluation, and local viscosity and vorticity velocity updates. Position Constraint Solving contains PBF and XPBD constraint projections and complete steps. Geometric Queries and Collision Detection comprises CCD and particle-based distance-field construction. Global Solves and Pressure Projection includes Poisson and implicit viscosity solves, Newton and projective-dynamics elasticity, and grid-based fluid steps with pressure projection.
paragraphs.zh: 为了比较不同计算结构中基准测试的结果，我们根据数值方法和计算结构将任务分为六类（图2）。 局部网格和晶格计算涵盖输运、LBM操作以及局部表面张力和相场更新。 粒子-网格方法包括传输算子以及完整的PIC/FLIP、APIC和MPM步骤。 局部相互作用更新涵盖显式弹性、接触力评估，以及局部黏度和涡度速度更新。 位置约束求解包含PBF和XPBD约束投影及完整步骤。 几何查询和碰撞检测包括CCD和基于粒子的距离场构建。 全局求解和压力投影包括泊松方程和隐式黏度求解、牛顿力学和投影动力学弹性，以及带有压力投影的网格流体步骤。

paragraphs.en: Agents perform best on local computations, particularly regular grid and lattice operations. All passing submissions with speedups above 1 × 1\times belong to the local grid and lattice category, and their gains are below 0.3%, with a median speedup of 1.001 × 1.001\times and a maximum of 1.002 × 1.002\times . These margins are smaller than the run-to-run variation of the timings (Section 3.4 ) and do not establish a performance advantage. Global solves and more complex workloads involving irregular data access, iterative updates, or coordination across multiple stages show larger performance gaps. Overall, agents are more successful at exploiting regular local parallelism than at jointly optimizing algorithmic choices, data organization, and execution across an entire simulation step.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在本地计算任务中表现最佳，尤其是常规网格和晶格操作。 所有速度提升高于 1 × 1\times 的通过提交都属于本地网格和晶格类别，其性能增益低于 0.3%，中位速度提升为 1.001 × 1.001\times，最大值为 1.002 × 1.002\times。 这些差距小于计时结果在单次运行之间的波动（第 3.4 节），因此无法证明存在性能优势。 全局求解以及涉及不规则数据访问、迭代更新或多个阶段间协调的更复杂工作负载，则表现出更大的性能差异。 总体而言，智能体在利用常规本地并行性方面的成效，优于在整个模拟步骤中联合优化算法选择、数据组织与执行方面的成效。

paragraphs.en: Near-reference performance is concentrated in LBM, streaming, collision, and surface-tension tasks, where regular indexing and local arithmetic are readily mapped to GPU threads. Advection and Cahn–Hilliard updates show larger gaps and more variation across systems. In third-order advection, for example, Opus processes all three velocity components in one kernel, whereas GPT launches separate component kernels. These implementations highlight opportunities to reuse interpolation data and combine stages even within otherwise regular workloads.

paragraphs.en: Spatial ordering alone does not ensure efficient transfers. In PIC/FLIP P2G, Gemini sorts particle indices but retains indirect particle reads and global atomics for each contribution. Opus packs particles into spatial tiles and accumulates in shared memory, reaching 0.556 × 0.556\times the reference speed versus Gemini’s 0.134 × 0.134\times . The reference further aggregates contributions by cell before merging them into shared memory (Appendix D.1 ). The remaining gap therefore involves both the cost of grouping particles and the granularity of accumulation; sorting or moving atomics into shared memory is only part of the optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠空间排序并不能确保高效的传输。 在 PIC/FLIP P2G 中，Gemini 会对粒子索引进行排序，但保留间接的粒子读取以及每次贡献的全局原子操作。 Opus 将粒子打包到空间瓦片中，并在共享内存中进行累加，其速度达到了参考速度的 0.556 × 0.556\times，而 Gemini 仅为 0.134 × 0.134\times。 参考方法还会进一步按单元格聚合贡献值，然后再将它们合并到共享内存中（附录 D.1）。 因此，剩余的差距既包括粒子分组所产生的开销，也包括累加的粒度问题；将排序或移动原子操作到共享内存只是优化的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Performance varies substantially even among correct implementations of local interactions. In DEM contact, both Opus and GPT pack particle records, but Opus traverses contiguous ranges in a spatial grid, whereas GPT searches hash buckets and filters candidates by cell coordinates. paragraphs.en: PBF implementations already exploit spatial reordering: Opus rebuilds cell offsets and rearranges particles during each constraint iteration, reaching 0.815 × 0.815\times reference speed on the standalone PBF solve. paragraphs.en: We evaluate Opus and GPT with one attempt at 0.5 × 0.5\times , 1.0 × 1.0\times , and 1.5 × 1.5\times the default time budget (Table 2 ). As the budget grows, Opus’s fast 0.5 \mathrm{fast}_{0.5} rises steadily (54%, 66%, and 76%), whereas GPT’s changes little (36%, 42%, and 40%). Correctness and pass rate remain at 100% except for Opus at 0.5 × 0.5\times , where both are 98%. paragraphs.en: We introduced GPUPhysBench, a benchmark of 50 GPU physics simulation tasks spanning individual operators and complete simulation steps. By evaluating coding agents in interactive development environments against numerical checks and expert reference implementations, GPUPhysBench measures both implementation correctness and execution efficiency. Our results show that frontier agents can correctly implement fully specified simulation methods, with the two strongest systems passing all tasks, while substantial performance gaps remain, particularly for collision detection, constraint solving, and iterative solvers. Analysis of generated code and development traces highlights the importance of numerical algorithm selection, data organization, and coordination across kernels. These findings motivate agents that reason jointly about numerical methods and GPU execution, and establish GPUPhysBench as a testbed for progress toward automated implementation of efficient physical simulators.

paragraphs.en: The agent’s working directory also contains the public driver run_poisson_neumann.py . It builds the benchmark system with Numba on a 256 3 256^{3} cell-centered grid: a solid cylinder along the z z -axis, of radius 0.18 0.18 of the grid width, is embedded in the box, the active cells are those containing any fluid, each off-diagonal coefficient is the negated fluid fraction of the face between two active cells, and each diagonal is the sum of these fractions, so every active row sums to zero. The right-hand side is b = A ​ x ⋆ b=Ax^{\star} for a manufactured field x ⋆ x^{\star} (a ramp plus seeded uniform noise, shifted to zero mean over the active cells), and the solver tolerance is 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Its run(folder, name) loads the compiled module and, on a fresh solver object each time, calls input() and exec() ; it returns the fastest of five timed calls after three discarded warm-up calls, together with the last call’s solution, read back by output() . Agents use it to test and time their builds.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的工作目录中还包含公共驱动程序 run_poisson_neumann.py。 它使用 Numba 在一个 256³ 的单元中心网格上构建基准系统：一个沿 z 轴的实心圆柱体（半径为网格宽度的 0.18）嵌入在盒子中，活跃单元格是包含任何流体的单元格，每个非对角线系数是两个活跃单元格之间面上流体分量的负值，而每个对角线元素则是这些分量的总和，因此每一行活跃单元格的总和为零。 右侧项为 b = A x ⋆，其中 x ⋆ 是一个人工构造的场（一个斜坡加上随机均匀噪声，并在活跃单元格上调整至零均值），求解器的容限为 10⁻⁶。 其 run(folder, name) 方法会加载编译好的模块，并在每次创建新的求解器对象时调用 input() 和 exec()；它返回五次计时调用中最快的一次（前三次作为预热调用被舍弃），同时返回最后一次调用的解，该解由 output() 读取。 智能体使用它来测试和计时它们构建的模型。

paragraphs.en: For scoring, the harness uses the same driver code together with a hidden driver, which the agent cannot read. paragraphs.en: The audit combines static checks with two LLM review sessions. Before compilation, static checks compare the protected CUDA interface against the starter code, ignoring comments and whitespace, and inspect the submitted build configuration. Changes to protected methods, members, bindings, or the error helper, attempts to redefine names used by the fixed code, and build changes beyond permitted compilation flags receive HARNESS MODIFIED . A separate check inspects allocate() and identified helper calls for prohibited operations, including kernel launches, copies, initialization, device configuration, stream or library-handle creation, and host-thread creation. Detected violations receive WORK OUTSIDE COMPUTE ; allocation and recognized non-executing size queries are allowed. For evaluation, the harness restores the fixed code and rebuilds the submission in a clean directory, so the scored module uses the prescribed input, timing, and output interface.
paragraphs.zh: 此次审计将静态检查与两次大型语言模型（LLM）审查环节相结合。 在编译之前，静态检查会将受保护的 CUDA 接口与初始代码进行比较（忽略注释和空白符），并检查提交的构建配置。 对受保护的方法、成员、绑定或错误辅助函数所做的更改、试图重新定义固定代码中使用的名称，以及超出允许编译标志的构建更改，都将触发“HARNESS MODIFIED”提示。 一项独立的检查会审查 allocate() 函数及已识别的辅助函数调用，以检测禁止操作，包括内核启动、复制、初始化、设备配置、流或库句柄创建，以及主机线程创建。 检测到的违规行为将收到“WORK OUTSIDE COMPUTE”提示；分配操作和已识别的非执行尺寸查询则被允许。 为进行评估，该测试框架会恢复固定代码，并在一个干净的目录中重新构建提交内容，以确保评分模块使用规定的输入、计时和输出接口。

paragraphs.en: We use Claude-Opus-5 through Claude Code for every evaluated system, with shared prompts and two separate read-only sessions. The transcript auditor receives only agent.log and checks online access and parallel agent execution. A deterministic scan of tool names omits the parallel-agent question when it detects no calls that could start an agent. The timer auditor receives only the submitted CUDA source and traces whether any algorithmic work occurs outside compute() , including work in constructors, initializers, cleanup, asynchronous host threads, or state reused across calls. The fixed exec() times compute() , so this check concerns the location and dependencies of the computation rather than rechecking the event scaffold. Initialization, input-dependent preparation, and layout conversion must all occur inside compute() on every call. Host synchronization, allocation, and device-buffer copies inside it are allowed.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个受评估的系统，我们都通过 Claude Code 使用 Claude-Opus-5，并采用共享提示词以及两个独立的只读会话。 转录审核员仅接收 agent.log，并检查在线访问权限以及并行智能体执行情况。 工具名称的确定性扫描在检测到没有可能启动智能体的调用时，会跳过并行智能体相关的问题。 计时器审核员仅接收提交的 CUDA 源代码，并追踪任何算法性工作是否发生在 compute() 之外，包括构造函数、初始化程序、清理过程、异步主机线程或跨调用重复使用的状态中的工作。 exec() 固定调用了 compute()，因此这项检查关注的是计算的位置和依赖关系，而非重新验证事件框架。 初始化、输入相关的准备以及布局转换都必须在所有调用中发生在 compute() 内部。 允许在 compute() 内部进行主机同步、内存分配和设备缓冲区复制。

sents.en: The fixed exec() times compute() , so this check concerns the location and dependencies of the computation rather than rechecking the event scaffold.
sents.zh: exec() 固定调用了 compute()，因此这项检查关注的是计算的位置和依赖关系，而非重新验证事件框架。

sents.en: Initialization, input-dependent preparation, and layout conversion must all occur inside compute() on every call.
sents.zh: 初始化、输入相关的准备以及布局转换都必须在所有调用中发生在 compute() 内部。

sents.zh: 允许在 compute() 内部进行主机同步、内存分配和设备缓冲区复制。

paragraphs.en: This division assigns explicit interface and API restrictions to deterministic checks and uses the LLM for contextual interpretation of execution traces and computation dependencies. paragraphs.en: Table 6 summarizes how each system uses its budget in the runs of Table 1 . Opus, GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek finish every task before the deadline, using a median of 25%–54% of the budget. GLM reaches the deadline on 4 tasks. paragraphs.en: For the Poisson solves, the Newton steps and the semi-implicit MPM step, the ratio records where the submission’s own iteration stopped relative to the required residual. For the semi-implicit MPM step, the worst ratio of every passing submission ( 0.60 0.60 ) instead comes from a consistency check between the returned particle and grid states. paragraphs.en: The two mc_r submissions at 0.56 0.56 and 0.60 0.60 are correct. Every mc_r submission scores at least 0.53 0.53 on the same hidden check. paragraphs.en: The p2g_pic_flip task transfers particle velocities onto a staggered MAC grid using trilinear weights. Each particle contributes mass and momentum to eight neighboring nodes for each velocity component, followed by normalization of momentum by mass. Nearby particles update overlapping grid nodes, making the organization of accumulation central to performance.
paragraphs.zh: p2g_pic_flip 任务使用三次线性权重将粒子速度转移到交错 MAC 网格上。 对于每个速度分量，每个粒子都会向八个相邻节点贡献质量和动量，随后对动量进行质量归一化。 附近的粒子会更新重叠的网格节点，因此累积的组织方式对性能至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Gemini sorts particle indices by grid-cell ID using CUB radix sort, then processes particles in that order. However, each thread still gathers particle data indirectly from the original arrays and performs global atomic additions for every particle-node contribution. Sorting improves spatial ordering without aggregating contributions before they reach global memory.

paragraphs.en: Opus groups particles into 8 × 8 × 8 8\times 8\times 8 cell tiles through counting and prefix sums, then packs their positions and velocities into contiguous tile buffers. One CUDA block handles each tile, accumulating mass and momentum in shared memory over a 10 × 10 × 10 10\times 10\times 10 region that includes the halo. The block then merges these values into global accumulators. This reduces global atomic traffic, but each particle still performs atomic updates within the shared-memory tile. All grouping, packing, accumulation, and normalization occur inside the timed compute() .
paragraphs.zh: Opus 通过计数和前缀和将粒子分组为 8 × 8 × 8 的单元格瓦片，然后将它们的位置和速度打包到连续的瓦片缓冲区中。 每个 CUDA 块处理一个瓦片，在包含光晕区域的 10 × 10 × 10 范围内，于共享内存中累积质量和动量。 随后，该块将这些值合并到全局累加器中。 这减少了全局原子操作流量，但每个粒子仍在共享内存瓦片内执行原子更新。 所有分组、打包、累积和归一化操作都在计时的 compute() 函数内部完成。

paragraphs.en: Opus and Gemini achieve speedups of 0.556 × 0.556\times and 0.134 × 0.134\times relative to the reference, respectively. The reference further sorts particles by cell within each tile and sums each cell’s particle contributions in registers before merging them into shared memory. Its fixed-capacity tile buckets also avoid a global counting-sort pass when capacity is sufficient, with a fallback for overflowing tiles. These differences illustrate why spatial grouping alone is insufficient: the granularity of aggregation and the cost of organizing particles both matter, even after most global atomics have been replaced by shared-memory accumulation.
paragraphs.zh: Opus 和 Gemini 相对于参考方法的速度提升分别为 0.556 × 0.556\times 和 0.134 × 0.134\times。 参考方法进一步在每张瓦片内按单元格对粒子进行排序，并将每个单元格的粒子贡献值累加到寄存器中，然后再将其合并到共享内存中。 其固定容量的瓦片分桶机制在容量足够时也能避免全局计数排序步骤，并为溢出瓦片提供了备用方案。 这些差异说明了为何仅靠空间分组是不够的：即使大多数全局原子操作已被共享内存累加所替代，聚合的颗粒度以及组织粒子的成本仍然至关重要。

paragraphs.en: This task solves a variable-coefficient Poisson system with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions on a 256 3 256^{3} grid. paragraphs.en: Gemini implements conjugate gradients with diagonal Jacobi preconditioning. Each iteration uses separate kernels for the matrix-vector product, dot products, solution and residual updates, and search-direction update. Two scalar reductions are copied back to the host in a typical iteration to compute the CG coefficients, introducing repeated synchronization. Periodic convergence checks recompute the true residual before accepting the solution and restart CG if necessary.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 采用对角雅可比预条件化实现共轭梯度法。 每次迭代分别使用内核执行矩阵-向量乘积、点积、解和残差更新，以及搜索方向更新。 在典型迭代中，两个标量归约结果会被复制回主机以计算 CG 系数，从而引入重复的同步操作。 周期性的收敛检查会在接受解之前重新计算真实残差，并在必要时重启 CG。

paragraphs.en: Opus also uses diagonal preconditioning, applying it through symmetric scaling of the system inside compute() . This folds the preconditioner into an operator with unit diagonal. One main kernel fuses the deferred solution update, search-direction update, matrix-vector product, and dot-product accumulation; another updates the residual and accumulates its norm. paragraphs.en: The benchmark covers fluid dynamics, deformable solids, and granular materials. The fluid tasks span Eulerian grid-based solvers ( Zehnder et al., 2018 ) , hybrid particle-grid methods such as particle-in-cell/fluid-implicit-particle (PIC/FLIP) and affine particle-in-cell (APIC) ( Jiang et al., 2015 ) , particle-based methods such as position-based fluids (PBF) ( Macklin and Müller, 2013 ) , and the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) ( Li et al., 2026b ) . They include both local operations, such as advection, particle-grid transfer, lattice collision and streaming, and phase-field evolution, and global or iterative computations, such as pressure projection and implicit viscosity. The solid and granular tasks cover mass-spring systems ( Liu et al., 2013 ) , the finite element method (FEM) ( Sifakis and Barbic, 2012 ) , the material point method (MPM) ( Stomakhin et al., 2013 ) , extended position-based dynamics (XPBD) ( Macklin et al., 2016 ) , continuous collision detection (CCD) ( Brochu et al., 2012 ) , and the discrete element method (DEM) ( Lu et al., 2022 ) . paragraphs.en: As Table 10 shows, the reference is 9.0 × 9.0\times faster than the best AMGX configuration. The gap comes from exploiting the structured grid. First, the reference coarsens geometrically, merging fixed 2 × 2 × 2 2\times 2\times 2 blocks, so every coarse level remains a 7-point stencil and is built in one averaging pass. AMGX instead builds its hierarchy algebraically from the matrix graph. Second, the reference’s V-cycle uses red-black Gauss–Seidel smoothing within tiles and repeated coarse-grid corrections, which reduces the iteration count. Third, each iteration is cheaper, because stencil storage reads about 3.5 × 3.5\times less matrix data than CSR and the kernels are fused on shared-memory tiles. AMGX targets arbitrary sparse matrices and cannot use this structure, and its configurations were not tuned. The comparison therefore measures the value of specializing to the task rather than a shortcoming of AMGX.

paragraphs.en: As Table 11 shows, the references are 2.6 2.6 – 7.0 × 7.0\times faster. In each case, the difference lies in how memory accesses and accumulation are organized, not in the arithmetic. The library ports process particles or elements in input order and scatter every contribution with global atomics, or read neighbor data indirectly from unsorted arrays. The references first sort the work spatially. They counting-sort particles into grid tiles for MPM and grains into cells for DEM, and they bin tetrahedra into Morton-ordered spatial bins for FEM. They then accumulate each tile or bin in shared memory before a single global update, and pack each grain’s state contiguously in cell order so that neighbor loops read cache-friendly records. The MPM reference also allocates grid storage only over the particles’ bounding box, and the FEM reference computes the rest-state quantities inside the force kernel instead of storing them.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 11 所示，参考实现的速度是 2.6 2.6 – 7.0 × 7.0\times。 在每个案例中，差异在于内存访问和累加的组织方式，而非算术运算本身。 该库端口按输入顺序处理粒子或元素，并通过全局原子操作散播每个贡献值，或者从未经排序的数组中间接读取邻居数据。 参考实现首先对工作数据进行空间排序。 它们对粒子进行计数排序，将其分配到网格瓦片中用于 MPM；对颗粒进行排序，将其分配到单元格中用于 DEM；并将四面体按 Morton 顺序分入空间分箱中用于 FEM。 随后，它们在单次全局更新前于共享内存中累加每个瓦片或分箱，并以单元格顺序连续存储每个颗粒的状态，使邻居循环能够读取缓存友好的记录。 MPM 参考实现还仅在粒子的边界框范围内分配网格存储，而 FEM 参考实现则在力核内部计算静止状态量，而非将其存储起来。

paragraphs.en: The reference implementations in GPUPhysBench are complete simulation steps rather than isolated kernels, so they can be advanced over many timesteps to produce full physical simulations. Figure 4 shows six such simulations, one per row, each driven by the reference implementation of a single benchmark task and run on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090. Each row shows four representative frames, with the simulated time given below each frame. Scene-specific ingredients that lie outside a task’s one-step specification, such as gravity, boundaries, contact with scene objects, and material plasticity, are supplied by the scene setup around the reference step.
paragraphs.zh: GPUPhysBench 中的参考实现是完整的模拟步骤，而非孤立的内核，因此可以跨越多个时间步长进行推进，从而生成完整的物理模拟。 图 4 展示了六次这样的模拟，每行一次，每次都由单个基准任务的参考实现驱动，并在 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 上运行。 每行显示四个代表性帧，每个帧下方标有模拟时间。 场景特定的要素若超出任务单步规格（例如重力、边界、与场景物体的接触以及材料塑性），则由参考步骤周围的场景设置提供。
